notes: Game rules: the tab now shows "When you host" (Use my rules / Standard rules), says where the rates apply (single player and games you host for friends or LAN with Use my rules; not in games open to everyone, someone else's game or Forever worlds), and warns on the tab when a rule was changed while the game runs (it applies after a restart). A value this version no longer offers falls back to the default and is never written back, so it cannot stop the game's backend from starting.
